messages:
Nia: Quick proposal 0 mins: split the monolithic structured-output doc into two PRs to speed reviews. PR1 = JSON Schema + static examples. PR2 = parsing patterns + SDK snippets + fallbacks. I'll open both and assign.

Diego: I can grab PR1 (schema/examples). Will add compact nullable-array examples and a JSON Schema validation snippet.

Priya: I'll take PR2 (parsing/sdk). Plan: small tryParse envelope example, a minimal regex fallback, and short SDK 4.x snippet showing parse fallback.

Owen: Please keep the SDK snippets in docs/parsers/snippets so other pages can import them. Also add a one-line migration note from SDK 3.x to 4.x for function-calling shapes.

Tess: I'll run a link audit and open a redirects PR for moved example paths. If schema PR lands first we should land redirects right after.

LintBot: Note: some code fences missing language tags and one JSON example has trailing comma; will block CI.

Nia: timeline 00: two draft PRs tomorrow, land both by Friday. If blocked ping me.

Diego: PR1 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900. Left TODO for lint fixes.

Priya: PR2 draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 with SDK snippets and fallback heuristics. Needs review for wording around PII and fallback safety.

Tess: Redirects PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/902. Includes sidebar updates and changelog blurb.

Owen: Reviewed PR1, leaving small style nits. good to merge after lint patch.

Diego: merged PR1 after lint fix.

Priya: merged PR2 after minor edits. Added the SDK 3.x -> 4.x blurb.

Tess: merged redirects PR and updated release-notes draft.

Nia: added a one-line release-notes entry: "Docs: split structured-output guidance; added parsing fallback examples and SDK migration note." Closing thread. :tada:
